title: Evaluation of the next parity node inputs
statement: Let $r,q$ be natural numbers, let $G$ be either an AND or OR gate, let $A$ assign a sign block to each of the $r^{q+1}$ groups, let $g$ index one of $r^q$ groups, and let $a$ be a sign assignment on $	ext{Fin}(r)$. Applying the gate dual to $G$ to the level-$q+1$ node values over the specified input set equals the exact dual-gate node value: it is the matching value precisely when $a$ equals the assignment whose $j$th sign is the product of the block $A$ assigns to child group $(g,j)$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a circuit gate, either AND or OR
$A$ assigns a sign block to each index in $	ext{Fin}(r^{q+1})$
$a$ is a sign assignment on $	ext{Fin}(r)$
